title: You've read the label a hundred times.
subtitle: You still don't know what's in it.
description: Scientific evidence. Human language. BOTIA reads ingredients, detects relevant signals, and connects them with clear explanations based on scientific, regulatory, and transparency sources.
stats_text: uncertain — in our first analysis of real supermarket products, 72% of results were uncertain, not because the ingredients were forbidden, but because the label simply didn't say enough to know.
evidence_desc: Scientific and regulatory evidence from WHO, EFSA, FDA, and Codex Alimentarius
woman_desc: Scientific evidence specific to women's biology, when it exists
animal_desc: What the label says about animal-derived ingredients — and what it doesn't
muslim_desc: Documented criteria for halal, haram, and mashbooh ingredients
highlight_text: BOTIA does not replace WHO, EFSA, the European Commission, FDA, or scientific literature. It translates complex food evidence into information that can be used while reading a label.
